summary: GymBuddy backend + frontend tested. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass across auth, onboarding, equipment filtering (Dumbbell Bench Press included / Barbell Bench Press excluded for user with dumbbells+bench; no barbell/smith_machine/leg_press/cable_machine items leak), exercises search/meta, plans templates+generate+duplicate, sessions start/finish/history, progress summary (empty + populated), food search/entry/summary, gamification, leaderboard opt-in, admin RBAC (403 for user, 200 for admin, non-root cannot demote, root admin cannot be modified), and subscription tier switching. Frontend web preview loads on mobile viewport (390x844): login screen, registration with min-8-char validation error, redirect to 11-step onboarding, admin login lands on dashboard (0 XP/0 workouts/Level 1 for fresh admin), /admin renders 4 tabs (Overview/Users/Media Audit/Reports) with 19 Users/1306 Exercises/2 Workouts counts, /exercises loads 1306 items with muscle chip filter, /progress shows BMI 24.7 with target/difference and 3 chart tabs, /food shows daily totals with Add Food + barcode icon. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) in project code. No React Native red screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponderTerminationRequest / onResponderGrant / onResponderMove / onResponderRelease / onResponderTerminate'. Cosmetic RN-Web responder-system warning; does not block interaction. Comes from Pressable/scroll internals. Reference: browser console during dashboard load.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Optionally silence RN-Web responder warnings by wrapping affected components with react-native-gesture-handler primitives or ignore-list them.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1270 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, plans, sessions, food, admin) for maintainability, but not blocking.

ProfileUpdate schema does not include an 'activity_level' field although review request mentioned it in onboarding payload - if the frontend needs it, add it. Currently onboarding accepts flat body and silently ignores unknown keys.
/plans/generate requires goal/experience/days_per_week and returns 422 on empty body - frontend Auto-Generate button must pass these (verify UI passes them since backend has no defaults).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1306 exercises + root admin on startup. Tests create ephemeral users via /api/auth/register (prefixed test_/ui_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds: admin@gymbuddy.app / AdminGym2026!. Onboarding endpoint accepts FLAT ProfileUpdate body (not {profile,equipment}); training frequency uses training_days list not training_days_per_week; goal values are build_muscle/gain_strength/lose_weight/etc. Templates and plans endpoints return {items:[...]} wrapper. /plans/generate requires goal, experience, days_per_week.
